attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole entry is two sentences and neither of them says what he was, so no `types` are set here: the day's line calls him «Άγιος» and nothing else, and no rank word, no century and no manner of death is printed. The page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. This is not the corpus's `nonna-mother-of-gregory-the-theologian`, who is a woman and kept on another day. No hymn is printed.
